hooks.name: Run Targeted Tests on BLoC/UseCase Save
hooks.description: Derives the mirrored test path from the saved BLoC or UseCase source file, runs it if it exists, and logs a message if not found.

action.command: TEST_PATH=$(echo "$KIRO_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|lib/features/|test/features/|' | sed 's|\.dart$|_test.dart|'); if [ -f "$TEST_PATH" ]; then flutter test "$TEST_PATH" 2>&1; else echo "[run-tests-on-save] No test file found at $TEST_PATH"; fi
